paper_title: Constraints on axion-like dark matter from a SERF comagnetometer
notes: NASDUCK-SERF SERF comagnetometer (3He + 39K) constrains both ALP-neutron (gaNN) and ALP-proton (gaPP) couplings. The headline novel result is the first reliable terrestrial bound on ALP-proton coupling, so AxionProton chosen as primary. Mass range 1.4e-12 to 2e-10 eV. 95% C.L. Data points are approximate readings from Fig. 2 (right panel, gaPP) since precise values are only in external repository [57]. DM density assumed standard ~0.4 GeV/cm^3 (Standard Halo Model). The paper also provides gaNN limits (AxionNeutron) in the range ~1e-6 to 1e-5 GeV^-1. epsilon_P=0.16, epsilon_N=0.85 used for spin content. | selector: text (sole candidate) | convention: AxionProton C_N/F_a [eV^-1] -> dimensionless g_aN (x1.877e+09) | Auto-corrected couplings: ×1e-14 (×1.00e-14, rule=argmin|log10(median*f)-log10(anchor=1.0e-10)|) | read-vote N=3: ct=AxionProton (2/3); medoid 0 of 2 curves (med pairwise 0.514 dex)
